name: LeatherBaseCoralFactory
caption: A white base mesh 3D model of a leather coral structure. The object shows the raw geometry of a soft coral colony — multiple smooth, fleshy lobes rise and curl from a central root point, each with gently wavy and scalloped margins. The form is compact and roughly dome-shaped with many petal-like protrusions. Without any texture or material color applied, the pure white smooth surfaces reveal the organic lobe topology with soft shadows indicating the depth between lobes.
